subject: PO mapping + evidence requirements for Helios Data (AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace)
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@heliosdata.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@heliosdata.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor setup & PO requirements — Redwood listing

Hi Camila/Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Our procurement team is ready to move forward but needs a concise checklist so they can issue a PO this month. Can you confirm the following for Redwood as a marketplace vendor?

- Registered legal entity name and remit address we should put on the PO
- Tax ID / VAT info (US EIN or EU VAT as applicable)
- Whether we should reference an AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace SKU or Redwood invoice number on the PO
- Billing contact and preferred invoice frequency (monthly/quarterly)
- Any mandatory fields your AP team requires (GL codes, department codes, flags)
- Security evidence (SOC2, encryption at rest, data residency statements) — our compliance team will want copies

Timeline: our target is to have a fully executed PO by 2026-11-16 so we can enable marketplace billing for the initial pilot. If you can send a single PDF with a sample PO + the security evidence we can circulate it internally.

One other note: which marketplace will this run through? We are evaluating AWS Marketplace but may also route through GCP depending on region. If there are differences in the intake form per marketplace let us know.

Thanks — appreciate the help.

Olivia Chen
Head of Procurement | Helios Data
olivia.chen@heliosdata.com

Attachments: Helios_Procurement_Intake_Form.pdf (xlsx stub)
From: camila.reyes@redwood.com
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@heliosdata.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor setup & PO requirements — Redwood listing

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Summary and next steps below (short checklist + attachments). I copied Ben for billing mapping.

Quick checklist (what we will provide):
- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit / invoice address: 1201 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789 (we will provide formal W-9)
- Marketplace reference: please include the marketplace SKU when available; otherwise reference your PO number in the invoice (we accept both)
- Billing contact: billing@redwood.com (attn: Ben Carter), invoices@redwood.com for automated ingestion
- Invoice cadence: monthly by default; we can support net-30 terms for approved enterprise customers
- Required AP fields: PO number, bill-to legal name, remit address, line item SKU (if using marketplace), and an optional GL code column (we will accept whatever you provide)
- Security evidence: attaching Redwood_Security_SSA.pdf (summary) and we can push SOC 2 Type II report via an NDA / secure link if needed

Attachments included: Helios_PO_Template.pdf (sample PO format you can use), Redwood_Security_SSA.pdf (summary of controls)

Marketplace notes: the intake differs slightly between AWS and GCP — AWS requires a Marketplace Product Code (ASC), GCP uses a listing ID. If you confirm which marketplace you want to bill through, we will add the correct SKU info to the sample PO.

Next steps: 
1) Please return the filled Helios_PO_Template.pdf with your PO number and remit details by 11/16.
2) If your compliance team needs the full SOC 2 report, let me know and I will arrange a secure transfer (we usually send via a signed NDA).
3) Ben will follow up with the exact invoice remit and GL mapping if you need a billing worksheet.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that speeds it up — otherwise we can proceed by email.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

Attachments: Helios_PO_Template.pdf (pdf stub), Redwood_Security_SSA.pdf (pdf stub)

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor setup & PO requirements — Redwood listing

Thanks Camila and Olivia — quick add from finance/marketplace billing side. Below is the PO mapping we recommend to avoid delays when your AP team ingests invoices:

Recommended PO layout (suggested fields to fill on your side):
- PO Number: (your internal PO reference — e.g., PO-HELIOS-12345)
- Vendor legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit address: 1201 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Invoice line: Redwood Marketplace consumption (include SKU if available)
- Quantity / period: 1 / monthly (or list monthly usage estimate)
- Unit price: leave blank if you prefer us to invoice based on usage, otherwise list subscription fee
- Payment terms: Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated
- Optional GL: we accept any code but including it in the PO helps speed posting

Action items for Helios: please return the Helios_PO_Template.pdf with PO Number and billing address filled. If you plan to route via AWS Marketplace please include the AWS product code (we will provide it once you tell us which product region you want active).

AP remit information (for Helios PO):
Redwood Inference, Inc.
Attn: Accounts Receivable / Ben Carter
1201 Market St, Suite 300
San Francisco, CA 94103

If you need a vendor registration packet (W-9 plus invoice sample plus billing worksheet) I can attach the Helios_Billing_Form.xlsx — Camila, please confirm if we should send that back to Olivia now.

On compliance: Olivia, we included a short SSA in Camila's email. For the full SOC 2 Type II report we can either: (a) provide a secure link after a signed NDA, or (b) schedule a call with our security team to review controls. Which does your team prefer?

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments: Helios_Billing_Form.xlsx (xlsx stub)
